parameters.description_en:
ID of the edge instance. You can obtain the ID by hovering the mouse over the name of the target edge instance on the **Edge Instances** page in the [edge computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list).

You can also call the [QueryEdgeInstance](~~135214~~) API to obtain the ID.
